description: This PHP file defines an abstract class `PDFEngine` within the `SuiteCRM\PDF` namespace, outlining the interface for PDF rendering engines. It includes method signatures for writing HTML content, headers, footers, adding CSS, creating blank pages, outputting PDFs, and configuring PDF options. The file also contains licensing and attribution comments relevant to SuiteCRM and SugarCRM.

classes.name: PDFEngine
classes.description: An abstract class serving as an interface for PDF rendering engines, defining methods for writing content, styling, and outputting PDFs.

methods.name: writeHTML
methods.description: Abstract method to write HTML content into the PDF output.

methods.name: writeFooter
methods.description: Abstract method to write footer content into the PDF.

methods.name: writeHeader
methods.description: Abstract method to write header content into the PDF.

methods.name: addCSS
methods.description: Abstract method to add CSS styles to the PDF content.

methods.name: writeBlankPage
methods.description: Abstract method to insert a blank page into the PDF.

methods.name: outputPDF
methods.description: Abstract method to generate and output the final PDF, given a filename, destination, and optional full name.

methods.name: configurePDF
methods.description: Abstract method to set options for PDF generation.
